speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you're experiencing fatigue and severe itching along with abnormal liver tests. To help narrow this down, can you tell me if you have noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or if your urine has become dark?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, I need to rule out Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, so I will request a MRCP scan and check your IgG4 levels. REQUEST TEST: MRCP, IgG4_level

speaker: Doctor
text: Since PSC and autoimmune pancreatitis are unlikely, let's look at viral causes. Have you experienced any nausea, abdominal pain, or a recent fever?

text: Given the strong association between ulcerative colitis and cholestatic liver disease, along with the exclusion of viral, autoimmune, and IgG4-related causes, the clinical picture is highly suggestive of Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis despite the normal MRCP, which can occur in early or small-duct disease.
